en.title: Where Winds Meet Reached Over 100 Million Players
en.description: Where Winds Meet is an open-world action-adventure RPG that came out in November 2025, and it has been very well received ever since.
en.fullContent:
Where Winds Meet is an open-world action-adventure RPG that came out in November 2025, and it has been very well received ever since.

Back in December 2025, the game reached 15 million players since its launch, and a mobile version was released that same month. It has now been announced that the game has reached 100 million players globally.

Where Winds Meet is a free wuxia game set during China's Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period. A few months ago, we did an interview with NetEase Games about the story behind the game.

On July 23, the beginning of the Hidden Mountain expansion was released, and during Gamescom 2026, the studio revealed that the Hidden Mountain third and final chapter will be launched on September 16; it also released a trailer.

The final chapter will make the player face Qianye, the antagonist who caused tragedy in the protagonist's life. It will also include two fights with special bosses, two open-world field bosses, and new gameplay features and activities.

The game lets you experience and learn about the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms era, as it has real historical figures and other characters that are rooted in real events.

en.title: Why Germany's military is betting on gamers
en.description: For the past 10 years, the German armed forces — the Bundeswehr — have been represented at Gamescom, Cologne's video game trade fair. They've been ...
en.fullContent:
For the past 10 years, the German armed forces — the Bundeswehr — have been represented at Gamescom, Cologne's video game trade fair. They've been criticized for trying to draw more young people into military careers.

Gamescom, which runs from August 26-30 in Cologne, is promoted as the world's largest video game trade show.

Last year, two-thirds of its non-industry visitors were male, with over 40% of them between the ages of 16 and 25. Those are precisely the young people the Bundeswehr, Germany's armed forces, is trying to reach as it urgently seeks to expand its ranks.

Germany's military aims to have 260,000 active-duty soldiers by 2035. The German government has supplied hundreds of billions of euros to modernize the country's armed forces. Defense has become a priority for Germany in the face of the current global security situation.

The Bundeswehr set up shop at Gamescom for the first time in 2016. It's been back every year since.

A brand-new, olive-green Caracal off-road vehicle is one of the main attractions. Alongside it are laptops belonging to the Bundeswehr's Center for Cyber Operations — tasked with cyber defense, among other responsibilities.

en.title: Professional gaming is brutal on the body – inside the growing field of treating esports injuries
en.description: Chinese esports player Jian “Uzi” Zi-hao was more than a star “League of Legends” player: He was so talented that his team structured its entire st...
en.fullContent:
Chinese esports player Jian “Uzi” Zi-hao was more than a star “League of Legends” player: He was so talented that his team structured its entire strategy around his abilities, funneling resources to him and another teammate, Shi “Ming” Sen-Ming, so the duo could lead the team to victory. Over the course of his career, he earned more than US$500,000 in tournament prize money.

And yet in 2020, Jian announced his retirement, his storied career cut short by chronic wrist and arm injuries.

Video games have a reputation for keeping people glued to the couch. But for those who compete against the best players in the world, gaming can be surprisingly physically and mentally taxing.

The best esports players often have grinding schedules. They’re expected to regularly practice, participate in scrimmages and compete in official matches. Even at the recreational level, esports players cite the mental toll: playing for hours a day, every day, to hone their skills so they can “climb the ladder.”

A 2021 study of Portuguese esports players found that 37% experienced anxiety and depression, and 45% experienced sleep disturbances. The most common physical injuries in esports generally fall under eye problems and musculoskeletal issues.

Prolonged screen time leads to many types of vision problems in gamers, from the more common eye fatigue to a decreased ability to focus. Furthermore, the light emitted from screens appears to contribute to sleep disturbances by disrupting the release of melatonin, the hormone that helps regulate your sleep-wake cycle.

en.title: The path to becoming Elden Lord begins today!
en.description: ELDEN RING Tarnished Edition is now available for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system! This version of the game also includes the expansion, “Shadow of t...
en.fullContent:
ELDEN RING Tarnished Edition is now available for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system! This version of the game also includes the expansion, “Shadow of the Erdtree,” additional armor, and custom skins for Torrent, your spectral steed.

Unravel the mysteries of the Elden Ring’s power. Encounter adversaries with profound backgrounds, characters with their own unique motivations for helping or hindering your progress, and fearsome creatures.

Guided by grace, brandish the power of the Elden Ring and become an Elden Lord in the Lands Between.

Below, you can find out more about the perilous journey ahead. And if you keep scrolling, we’ve also gathered five quick tips that could help you stay alive.

Journey through the Lands Between, a fantasy world from Hidetaka Miyazaki, creator of the influential DARK SOULS video game series, and best-selling fantasy author, George R. R. Martin.

Traverse the breathtaking world on foot or on horseback, alone or online* with other players, and fully immerse yourself in the grassy plains, suffocating swamps, spiraling mountains, foreboding castles and other sites of grandeur.
